name: Trirealm Rift Blizzards
effectText: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) 3 cards from the top of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Trirealm Rift Blizzards" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and your opponent controls more monsters than you do: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished Level 5 or higher "Trirealm Rift" monsters, also you cannot activate non-"Trirealm Rift" cards or effects for the rest of this turn.
